gen-gf-bonbon-montserrat: Montserrat glides along with wide-open curves and a wiry line, while Bonbon's casual, heavy pen strokes sit above it like handwriting. Best for a handful of lines.
gen-gf-bonbon-satoshi: Inviting is Bonbon, thick and handwritten, with open-throated letters that feel personal. Satoshi takes over where Bonbon stops: Bonbon charms in a few words, while Satoshi's tall, uniform-width sans suits brief copy.
gen-gf-bonbon-switzer: Personal and inviting, Bonbon looks hand-inked and heavy in the middle. Switzer's tubular, wire-like letters then carry on without any visible thick and thin, a smooth ride for a handful of lines.
gen-gf-bonbon-work-sans: Work Sans reads modern and tidy, its mean line set high and every letter bent like a single length of wire. Bonbon feels warmer beside it, heavy and handwritten, so the pair is friendly yet crisp for a handful of lines.
gen-gf-bowlby-one-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and friendly, its small gap between lowercase and caps keeping lines compact. And Bowlby One lets its fat bowls fill the line above, so the pair is loud on top and warm below.
gen-gf-bowlby-one-sc-fs-paquito: Distinctive Bowlby One SC stands tall like squared-off woodblock type with pinched, sealed-looking mouths. But Paquito, a confident classic serif, is not meant for long paragraphs, so it grows tiring over a longer stretch.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-amulya: Amulya reads modern, with generous gaps in its curves that keep the letters open. And Bpmf Iansui does the hand-drawn charm with its toothpaste-smooth strokes, while Amulya handles everything else, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-neco: Bpmf Iansui looks hand-drawn and relaxed, with diagonals as thick as its upright strokes. But Neco brings a mellow swing from thick to thin, a text serif that feels dignified and never pinches shut.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-plein: Bpmf Iansui writes like toothpaste squeezed in one steady line, its s open and its spine matching its terminals in thickness. Plein, a plain sans, follows with reliable, clean round letters that are comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-bpmf-iansui-fs-recia: Authoritative Recia is a classic serif with light modulation you notice only up close. Over a longer passage it stays open and steady, a lettering-pen rhythm under Bpmf Iansui's soldered, hand-drawn strokes.
